PPLA:
(Push, Pull, Legs, Arms).
Day One (Push):
Sets x Reps | Alternative Exercises
1. Bench Press (Barbell) | 4 x 6-8 | - Bench Press (Dumbbell)
- Bench Press (Machine)
1. Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell) | 3 x 8-12 | - Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
- Landmine Press (T-Bar)
1. Lateral Raise (Dumbbell) | 3 x 8-12(Can do more sets and drop set!) | - Cross Body Lateral Raise (Cable)
Day Two (Pull):
1. Bent Over Row (Barbell) 3 x 8-12 - Single-Arm Row (Dumbbell)
- T-Bar Row
Day Three:REST
Day Four (Legs):
1. Squat (Barbell) | 3 x 6-12 | - Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
Day Five (Arms):
1. Cable Curl (Straight bar) | 3x8-12 | - EZ Curl (21s)
Day Six: REST
Day Seven: REST
Important Training Info
Example: 3 × 8–12 Dumbbell Curls = 8–12 reps each arm
